healthcheck.name: CRAFTFLOW plugin files are present
healthcheck.command: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; import sys; path = Path('plugins/craftflow/.claude-plugin/plugin.json'); ok = path.exists(); print('ok' if ok else 'missing'); sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)"

scenarios.name: Publication audit passes
scenarios.given: The repo contains the expected plugin, docs, and safety files
scenarios.when: The harness runs the publication audit

scenarios.name: Replay checker passes
scenarios.given: The workflow fixtures and contracts are internally consistent
scenarios.when: The harness replays the deterministic safety fixtures

scenarios.name: Worktree merge guard scenarios pass
scenarios.given: Real scratch git repos simulate every distinct outcome of craftflow_worktree_lock_staleness.py's decide() (self-reclaim gated on positive worktree-death proof, the still-live-worktree no-reclaim negative control, stale-worktree-gone, age-based stale-inactive including both the missing-metadata.json and corrupt-JSON variants, plain contention, the benign fresh-lock-no-metadata race, a lock-metadata read error, and both the launch-failure and non-zero-exit forms of a git-worktree-list failure) and of craftflow_worktree_copy_fallback.py's apply_copy_fallback() (a combined Added/Modified/Deleted/Renamed-with-space exercise, an AA conflict rejection, an RD missing-rename-source rejection, a preserved working symlink, a rewritten absolute symlink, a preserved chained symlink, and a brand-new untracked top-level directory), plus the broader dirty-tree and merge-conflict guard-sequence properties
scenarios.when: The harness subprocess-invokes the real craftflow_worktree_lock_staleness.py and craftflow_worktree_copy_fallback.py scripts (the exact files SKILL.md step 4 shells out to) against each scenario
scenarios.then: Each scenario resolves to the documented gate/outcome from skills/craftflow-router/SKILL.md step 4

scenarios.name: Latency audit reads fixture telemetry
scenarios.given: Fixture telemetry is present in the repo
scenarios.when: The harness runs the latency audit against fixtures
scenarios.then: The audit completes without parse errors

scenarios.name: Hook unit tests pass
scenarios.given: The new hook scripts (memory-protect, sdd-cache) and structural additions are present
scenarios.when: The hook unit test runner executes
scenarios.then: All unit tests pass and exit cleanly
